page.overview:
Who is Kuja?

Kuja is the primary antagonist of Final Fantasy IX. Weaving his schemes from the shadows, he initially bends events to his will by manipulating Queen Brahne of Alexandria. His ultimate ambition, however, is to acquire the power of the eidolons for himself and dominate Gaia. He is a powerful sorcerer and rides a silver dragon.

Kuja's speech is laced with metaphors, calling Garnet a "canary" and Brahne "the elephant-lady". This refined eloquence starkly contrasts his true nature as a sadistic warmonger. His penchant for opulence and luxury is evident in his lavish home at the Desert Palace and his frequent visits to the nobles' district in Treno.

Kuja has silver hair that falls halfway down his back. At 24 years old, Kuja is the youngest main antagonist in the Final Fantasy series. He wears a large feather in his hair, has light blue eyes and pale complexion, and is of medium height and light build. He wears white sleeves with a violet mantle around his shoulders. A white robe covers the back of his legs down to his ankles held up by four straps that act as a codpiece. He wears armored, dark purple boots with golden buckles.

When in Trance, Kuja becomes covered in red fur and his clothes, which turn white, become tattered. He has a long furred tail in this form.
